subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a core config surface now, and what should the no-override versus explicit-tier semantics be?
rationale: The source gap and user value are clear, but this adds a public prompt-context config knob that overlaps existing bootstrap budgets, `contextInjection`, lightweight mode, and hook-extra behavior.

options.title: Sponsor the focused tier contract

options.title: Decline the new config knob
